Name: DGR 013 - SURTR
Information:
**DGR 013 - SURTR**

SURTR is a high-powered assault unit meant to support other units from the air. It is built to demolish smaller units and non-frame unit enemy forces, which it can clear out using powerful elemental bombardments from a massive cannon built into its body. The unit creates a constant vibrational barrier in the air that can repel attacks that lack momentum, allowing it to avoid being hit by attacks fired too far past their operational range.

**DGRs**

DGRs are a type of frame unit built by the ancient framebilt for a war between gods, though many never got to see proper use. Units are now being rediscovered across Somnus Domina, most buried across Retia, and are being brought back into use. However, as they’re discovered, many are falling into the hands of those who might abuse them for their own gain.

traits.name: Discriminate Salvo Strikes
traits.description: All damage dealt by DGR using its Eidoburst Calibre Cannon and Warhead Flare is doubled when dealt to targets who are smaller than it.

traits.name: Ranged Repulsion Generator
traits.description: Ranged attacks made against the DGR at a weapon’s long range automatically miss unless they score a critical hit.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The DGR makes two Eidoburst Calibre Cannon attacks.

actions.name: Eidoburst Calibre Cannon
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 180/540 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) cold, fire, lightning, or force damage (the DGR chooses when it hits).

actions.name: Warhead Flare
actions.description: The DGR fires a charged burst of energy at a point it chooses within its Eidoburst Calibre Cannon’s normal range, where it detonates in a 20-foot radius sphere centered there. Each creature in that space must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d10 cold, fire, lightning, or force damage on a failure, or half as much on a success (the DGR chooses when it uses this action). Creatures who are Large or larger take half damage instead.

actions.name: Mach Maneuver
actions.description: The DGR doubles its movement speed until the start of its next turn and takes the Dodge action.

bonus_actions.name: Targeted Strike
bonus_actions.description: The DGR’s next Eidoburst Calibre Cannon attack this turn can treat its long range as its normal range.
